visual_action: The video starts with an aerial night shot of Washington D.C., showing the U.S. Capitol Building and the Washington Monument. The shot pans slightly. It then cuts to the Democratic Party logo (a blue 'D' inside a blue circle on a white background). A realistic human mouth and eyes are superimposed on the 'D', which move as if speaking.

cast.name: Democratic National Committee
cast.evidence: The on-screen text says "The DNC isn't on TikTok...". The logo shown is that of the Democratic Party. The account is @democrats.

spoken_summary: There is no dialogue, only music with lyrics. The lyrics from the song "The Man" by Aloe Blacc are heard: "Go ahead and tell everybody / I'm the man, I'm the man, I'm the man / Yes I am, yes I am, yes I am". The lyrics are used to communicate the DNC's arrival on TikTok.
audio_music: The video is set to the upbeat and confident song "The Man" by Aloe Blacc, which plays throughout. The lyrics directly correspond to the on-screen text and the video's message of confident arrival.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single, quick cut from the initial scenic shot to the animated logo.
manipulation_or_satire: A realistic human mouth and eyes are digitally superimposed onto the Democratic Party's 'D' logo, animating it to make it appear as if it is a talking character. This is a common meme format used for humorous effect.
cultural_references: The song "The Man" by Aloe Blacc.
The meme format of superimposing a realistic mouth and eyes onto an inanimate object or logo to make it appear to be speaking or singing.
central_claim: The Democratic National Committee is now on TikTok, contrary to any assumptions that it wouldn't be.
intended_effect: To humorously announce the DNC's presence on TikTok and portray the party as self-aware and in touch with internet culture.
